windowMs.description: Rolling window for the rate and volume limits (default 60000 ms, range 60000-86400000; tighten-only, a shorter window would raise the rate).

maxMessagesPerWindow.description: Most sends allowed to one destination per window (default 60, range 1-60; tighten-only). One tool call counts once, however many string arguments it has.

maxBytesPerWindow.description: Most characters allowed to one destination per window (default 262144, range 1-262144; tighten-only).

minIntervalMs.description: Minimum spacing between sends to one destination; a faster send is delayed (default 0 = off).

timingQuantumMs.description: Snap send times to a grid of this many ms, so the send time within a grid cell carries no bits (default 0 = off).

jitterMs.description: Random jitter added on top of timing quantization (default 0 = off). Requires timingQuantumMs > 0.

releaseCadenceMs.description: Constant-rate paced release: consecutive sends to one destination leave at least this many ms apart, so the observed interval is input-independent (default 0 = off). The strongest timing-channel defense; adds queueing latency.
